skill.learned.speaker: Greybeard
skill.learned.text: That's it. Remember the feel, not the name of the move.

skill.tutor_deny.speaker: Greybeard
skill.tutor_deny.text: Gold — or you've already topped out.

soul.equipped.speaker: System
soul.equipped.text: Soul set in the slot. The blade's temperament has changed.

soul.ritual_not_enough.speaker: Starreader
soul.ritual_not_enough.text: That much dust won't light a single corner.

soul.fused.speaker: Starreader
soul.fused.text: Three on the same orbit become one brighter star.

soul.fuse_requirement.speaker: Starreader
soul.fuse_requirement.text: Three of the same star, grade and tier — and none of them set.

forge.need_rusty_first.speaker: Ding
forge.need_rusty_first.text: Let me see that rusty iron of yours first.

forge.path_chosen.speaker: System
forge.path_chosen.text: For souls, go read the stars with the Starreader. Power {power}.

forge.wood_sword_no_gold.speaker: Ding
forge.wood_sword_no_gold.text: Twenty gold. No money, don't block my forge.

forge.wood_sword_owned.speaker: Ding
forge.wood_sword_owned.text: Wooden sword? You already took one.

forge.tier_max.speaker: Ding
forge.tier_max.text: That's enough. Go cut that lion first.

forge.no_gold.speaker: Ding
forge.no_gold.text: Where's the gold? Take a lap outside the walls.

forge.pity_break.speaker: Ding
forge.pity_break.text: (Slams the hammer on the anvil) Enough! The iron has more patience than you!

forge.pity_break.speaker: System
forge.pity_break.text: The hammer lands by the forge and sparks scatter.

forge.pity_break.speaker: Ding
forge.pity_break.text: …Take it, a cake to cool off. Come back tomorrow, and don't show me that face today.

forge.pity_break.speaker: System
forge.pity_break.text: You recover some health. The failure streak resets.

forge.failed.speaker: Ding
forge.failed.text: Failed. The tier stays. The materials don't.
